_notes.method: 2023-25 pbp x injury reports: team-games where the season's top-share player (WR1 tgt>=.18, RB1 car>=.35, TE1) was Out/Doubtful. pickup = (beneficiary share absent - present) / vacated share, median by role.
_notes.WR1_out_qb_note: COUNTERINTUITIVE: team QB pass yards RISE ~13% (median, n=34) when the WR1 sits, and team target volume is unchanged (x1.01). Likely game-script confounding (injury-hit teams trail and throw). Application: NO QB downgrade for a WR1 absence; redistribute targets to the other pass-catchers.
_notes.deep_roles: WR4+ medians are noisy artifacts of tiny baselines; pooled at ~0.10 in application.
_notes.TE1_out: n=9, thin; applied at half weight.
